segments.an7.31:1.1: “Sattime, bhikkhave, upāsakassa parābhavā … pe … sattime, bhikkhave, upāsakassa sambhavā.
segments.an7.31:1.4: Bhikkhudassanaṃ na hāpeti, saddhammassavanaṃ nappamajjati, adhisīle sikkhati, pasādabahulo hoti, bhikkhūsu theresu ceva navesu ca majjhimesu ca anupārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti na randhagavesī, na ito bahiddhā dakkhiṇeyyaṃ gavesati, idha ca pubbakāraṃ karoti.
segments.an7.31:1.11: Ime kho, bhikkhave, satta upāsakassa sambhavāti.
segments.an7.31:4.3: Tattheva ca pubbakāraṃ, yo karoti upāsako.
segments.an7.31:8.3: Idheva ca pubbakāraṃ, yo karoti upāsako.
segments.an7.31:10.3: Bodhisaññā dve ca hāni, vipatti ca parābhavoti.
